body.statement: The optimal value of \(\mathsf P_{\mathrm{MILP}}\) equals \(D^{\star}\). For every integral selection vector \(z\), minimizing over \(b\) assigns each pair \((\pi,x)\) to a cheapest selected matching column or the dummy column and yields \(v=\max_{\pi\in\mathcal F}R_{\pi}(S_z)\), where \(S_z=\{c\in\mathcal C:z_c=1\}\).
body.justification: The mixed-integer formulation is proof-carrying implementation infrastructure for the causal width identity, not a new facility-location algorithm.
body.gap: AnthonyGoyalGuptaNagarajan2010 already studies min-max nearest-facility optimization. This corollary records an exact rational formulation for the causal cost tensor after the causal theorem has derived that tensor.
body.consumer: A trial team can optimize over thousands of candidate model versions using standard mixed-integer solvers while retaining an exact target objective.
